name: Hashimoto Kotarou
source:
Star Sign: Pisces

In order to become a stage actor he came from the countryside to the big city. He's currently working part-time while striving towards his dream. He's started getting some small bit parts with his acting troupe, but he's still an underling.
He meets the protagonist while handing out leaflets in the park.
Even though he doesn't have much spending money he likes to come to La Crima to see the protagonist and buy a little something for her sake.
He's working hard on his dream and doesn't think he has time for dating, but he still gets a little jealous when he sees the protagonist talking to other guys.
